notes.title: The Guru Guru demo will be ending this weekend!
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for playing! The limited-time [i]Guru Guru[/i] demo will close on July 6th (this weekend)![/p][p]We've received tons of valuable feedback that's given us many new ideas for developing [i]Guru Guru[/i]! Recently, our dev team has been working hard to improve game feel, gameplay mechanics, and performance optimization.[/p][p]After the demo period, we'll be launching a small-scale playtest recruitment to test these new improvements! Stay tuned for sign-up details![/p]

notes.title: Come share your Guru Guru demo feedback with the dev team
notes.content: [p]The [i]Guru Guru[/i] demo has been live for almost a week now![/p][p]A huge thanks to all the players who've tried our demo! We've received tons of feedback about game issues, and the dev team is working around the clock to squash those bugs!![/p][p]While playing, if you have any thoughts - whether it's about game bugs, suggestions for content, gameplay features you'd like to see added, or ideas for new cute animals and skills - please share them in the comments![/p][p][/p][p]Let's work together to make [i]Guru Guru[/i] even more fun!!![/p][p]You're also welcome to submit feedback through the in-game feedback channel![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100290/58151de04fe53747139be21028370b9a5f35d853.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 2025/6/13 Update Patch
notes.content: [p]2025/6/13 Update Patch[/p][list][*][p]Fixed lag issues on certain device models[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where after a room disbanded during combat, players would attempt to re-enter the room when exiting matchmade battles[/p][/*][*][p]New users will now have their language automatically selected based on region during first login[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where random terrain generation on the Rooftop map could occasionally trap players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI freeze when accepting friend invitations while on the main menu or character selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some small animals' eyes wouldn't display on medium graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized some physics calculations to improve performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where cookies could sometimes be knocked out of visible bounds on the Cookie map[/p][/*][/list]
